concept: The eclipse - only in the dark can the corona be seen
theme: Obscurity reveals what you are made of.
quote: The shadow passes. The fire does not.
core_metaphor: Total solar eclipse: the corona invisible until the light is covered.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: a moon sliding across a blazing gold sun in deep space, totality revealing a delicate bone-white corona and crimson prominences, holding in the dark, then a diamond-ring flash as the light returns.

hook.text: You think being overshadowed means you disappeared. Look closer.
hook.visual: 9:16 vertical, deep space black (#050508): a blazing gold (#C6A94F) sun, the dark disc of a moon sliding slowly across it. The light dims frame by frame. Camera static, center frame, symmetrical.

build.text: When the moon covers the sun, the world goes dark. Only then can you see the corona. The fire that was always there.
build.visual: Totality: the sun fully covered and a delicate bone-white (#F5F2EB) corona erupting outward in fine filaments around the black disc, flickering with slow plasma motion. Awe, silence, extreme detail.

pivot.text: The season that hides you is the season that shows you what you are made of.
pivot.visual: Slow push-in on the corona's edge: a solar prominence arcs outward in crimson (#DC143C) and gold, enormous and alive, visible only because of the darkness. Cosmic scale, high contrast.

resolution.text: Stay lit in the dark. Keep burning while nobody is looking. The shadow passes. The fire does not.
resolution.visual: Medium shot: the corona holds steady and bright around the dark disc as stars appear around it. Camera holds, then drifts a few degrees. Calm, powerful, patient.

mobius_close.text: Because one day the light comes back, and everyone will finally see what you...
mobius_close.visual: The moon begins to slide away and a diamond-ring flash of gold light breaks out at the edge, flooding the frame, returning toward the opening geometry. Unresolved.

caption: Only in the dark can you see the corona. Keep burning while nobody's looking. The shadow passes.
